content.text:
I've kept the response due date as "Tomorrow," with the exact calendar date to be filled in when you issue the RFx.

Because of the short window, I added a term asking vendors to flag any line, document or questionnaire item they can't meet by the deadline. That lets you see gaps early, especially for the three new-vendor peptide and rosemary lines.

Do you want me to add a question to the questionnaire on whether the vendor can supply samples or CoAs within the same window?
